constructedSubset.assumption: 2 EZ-Tree LOD0 shade trees + 3 LOD0 shrubs + existing scalar landmark/plaza only. No flowering tree, hero, extra PBR, surroundings or reflection geometry. NOT a complete G1 scene.
constructedSubset.notes: Triangles and per-asset meshes from generated geometry; scene sum is an estimate, not a rendered combination. Shadow/depth/reflection passes add work. Instancing/merging not implemented.

publisherSubset.assumption: Published approximate 312K Jacaranda ×2 + 52K Shrub02 ×3 + measured construction study; not acquired source counts, not all final assets

projection.assumption: Pinhole upright extent centered perpendicular to view, 1080px backing height, 55deg vertical FOV. Approximation; no perceptual quality threshold or frame-time result.
